name: add_comment_to_pending_review
description: Add a comment to the requester's latest pending pull request review. The pending review must already exist (check with the user if unsure).

line.description: Diff line the comment applies to; for multi-line comments, the last line of the range

path.description: Relative path of the file to comment on

side.description: Diff side: LEFT = previous state, RIGHT = new state

startLine.description: For multi-line comments, the first line of the range

startSide.description: For multi-line comments, the diff side of the first line: LEFT = previous state, RIGHT = new state

name: add_issue_comment
description: Add a comment and/or reaction to an issue or issue comment. Also use it for pull requests (pass the PR number as issue_number), unless the user specifically wants to add or react to review comments. Requires body or reaction.

body.description: Comment text. Required unless reaction is given.

comment_id.description: Numeric ID of the issue or PR comment to react to; omit to react to the issue or PR itself. Cannot be combined with body.

issue_number.description: Issue or PR number to comment on or react to

reaction.description: Emoji reaction. Required unless body is given.

name: add_reply_to_pull_request_comment
description: Reply to and/or add an emoji reaction to an existing pull request comment. Requires body or reaction.

body.description: Reply text. Required unless reaction is given.

commentId.description: Numeric ID of the PR review comment to reply or react to: the number from a #discussion_r... anchor, not the GraphQL thread node ID (PRRT_...).

pullNumber.description: Pull request number. Required with body.

reaction.description: Emoji reaction. Required unless body is given.

name: assign_copilot_to_issue
description: Assign Copilot to an issue in a GitHub repository, so it creates a pull request with code changes that resolve the issue.

base_ref.description: Git ref (e.g. branch) the agent starts from. Defaults to the repo's default branch

custom_instructions.description: Optional extra context, constraints or guidance for the agent beyond the issue body

name: create_branch
description: Create a new branch in a GitHub repository

name: create_or_update_file
description: Create or update a single file in a GitHub repository remotely; not for local files. Updating an existing file requires its blob SHA: call get_file_contents with the same owner, repo and path and ref set to this tool's branch; the first text result reports it.

allow_symlink_write.description: Set true to update a symbolic link itself; content must be its new target path.

branch.description: Branch to create/update the file in

content.description: File content exactly as it should be written. Don't base64-encode it; the server does that.

path.description: Path of the file to create/update

sha.description: Blob SHA of the file being replaced. Required if the file exists. Get it with get_file_contents (same owner, repo, path; ref = this tool's branch).

name: create_pull_request
description: Create a new pull request in a GitHub repository.

reviewers.description: Usernames or ORG/team-slug teams to request reviews from

name: create_repository
description: Create a GitHub repository in your account or an organization

organization.description: Organization to create it in (omit for your personal account)

name: delete_file
description: Delete a file from a GitHub repository

branch.description: Branch to delete the file from

path.description: Path to the file to delete

name: fork_repository
description: Fork a GitHub repository to your account or specified organization

name: get_commit
description: Get details for a commit from a GitHub repository

detail.description: Detail for changed files: none omits stats and files; stats (default) gives per-file filename, status and line counts (additions, deletions, changes) without patches; full_patch adds each file's unified diff and can be very large.

sha.description: Commit SHA, branch name, or tag name

name: get_file_contents
description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitHub repository

fields.description: Fields to return per entry when path is a directory (default all; ignored for a file), e.g. just 'name' and 'type', to reduce response size.

sha.description: Optional commit SHA; used instead of ref

name: get_label
description: Get a specific label from a repository.

name: get_latest_release
description: Get the latest release in a GitHub repository

name: get_me
description: Get the authenticated GitHub user's details. Use for the user's own GitHub profile, or when other tool calls need missing info.

name: get_release_by_tag
description: Get a specific release by its tag name in a GitHub repository

name: get_tag
description: Get details about a specific git tag in a GitHub repository

name: get_team_members
description: Get member usernames of a team in an organization. Limited to organizations accessible with current credentials

org.description: Organization login (owner) that contains the team

name: get_teams
description: Get the teams a user is a member of. Limited to organizations accessible with current credentials

name: issue_read
description: Read one issue in a GitHub repository; method selects what to get.

method.description: get: issue details, plus best-effort hierarchy flags (`has_parent`, `has_children`), optional `parent` and `sub_issues_summary`, and `closed_by_pull_requests` (`total_count` plus up to 5 `references` to PRs set to close it). get_comments: comments. get_sub_issues: child issues. get_parent: parent issue, if this is a sub-issue. get_labels: assigned labels.

name: issue_write
description: Create a new issue or update an existing one in a GitHub repository.

assignees.description: Usernames to assign to this issue

duplicate_of.description: Number of the issue this one duplicates. Required when state_reason is 'duplicate'.

delete.description: True clears this field's current value; false or omitted is ignored. Cannot be true with 'value' or 'field_option_name'.

field_name.description: Field name (case-insensitive); must match a field from list_issue_fields for this repo or its org.

field_option_name.description: Option name for single-select fields, validated against the field's options before the API call. Cannot be combined with 'value' or 'delete: true'.

value.description: Value for text, number or date fields (date as YYYY-MM-DD). For single-select, prefer 'field_option_name' (validated before the API call). Cannot be combined with 'field_option_name' or 'delete: true'.

issue_fields.description: Field values to set or clear. Each item needs 'field_name' and exactly one of 'value', 'field_option_name' or 'delete: true'.

labels.description: Labels to apply to this issue

method.description: Write operation on a single issue

parent_issue_number.description: Parent issue number; the new issue is created and attached to it in one operation. Only for method 'create'; cannot be combined with issue_fields.

parent_owner.description: Owner of the parent issue's repo. Give with parent_repo, or omit both to use owner and repo. Only for 'create' with parent_issue_number.

parent_repo.description: Repo name of the parent issue. Give with parent_owner, or omit both to use owner and repo. Only for 'create' with parent_issue_number.

state_reason.description: Reason for the state change. Ignored unless state is changed.

type.description: Issue type; on update, null removes it. Only if issue types are enabled for the repo; get valid values from list_issue_types for this repo or its org. Omit if the repo doesn't support issue types.

name: list_branches
description: List branches in a GitHub repository

name: list_commits
description: List commits on a branch in a GitHub repository. At least 30 per page by default; up to 100 via perPage.

author.description: Filter by author username or email

fields.description: Fields to return per commit (default all), e.g. just 'sha' and 'html_url', to reduce response size.

path.description: Only commits containing this file path

sha.description: Commit SHA, branch or tag to list from (default: the repo's default branch). With a commit SHA, lists commits up to it.

since.description: Only commits after this date (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DD)

until.description: Only commits before this date (ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ or YYYY-MM-DD)

name: list_issue_fields
description: List issue field definitions for a repository, or for the org when repo is omitted: name, type (text, number, date, single_select) and, for single_select, valid option names.

repo.description: Repository name; returns its fields (inherited from its organization). Omit for org-level fields.

name: list_issue_types
description: List supported issue types for a repository, or for its owner organization when repo is omitted.

repo.description: Repository name. Omit for org-level issue types.

name: list_issues
description: List issues in a GitHub repository. To paginate, pass the previous response's pageInfo endCursor as 'after'.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response

value.description: Value to match: single-select option name (e.g. "P1"), YYYY-MM-DD for dates, a numeric string for numbers, or the text for text fields.

field_filters.description: Filter by custom issue field values; the server looks up each field and coerces the value to its type.

fields.description: Fields to return per issue (default all). Omitting 'body' and 'field_values' drops the largest data.

orderBy.description: Field to order issues by; requires 'direction'

state.description: Filter by state (default: open and closed)

name: list_pull_requests
description: List pull requests in a GitHub repository. If the user names an author, use search_pull_requests instead.

fields.description: Fields to return per pull request (default all). Omitting 'body' drops the largest data.

head.description: Filter by head user/org and branch

name: list_releases
description: List releases in a GitHub repository

fields.description: Fields to return per release (default all). Omitting 'body' drops the largest data.

name: list_repository_collaborators
description: List collaborators of a GitHub repository. Paginated: pass the response's `nextPage` as `page` for the next page (it also has `prevPage`, `firstPage`, `lastPage`).

affiliation.description: Filter by affiliation: outside = outside collaborators, direct = all with permissions regardless of org membership, all = all collaborators (default)

name: list_tags
description: List git tags in a GitHub repository

name: merge_pull_request
description: Merge a pull request in a GitHub repository.

expectedHeadSha.description: The expected SHA of the pull request's HEAD ref

name: pull_request_read
description: Read one pull request in a GitHub repository; method selects what to get.

after.description: Pagination cursor for get_review_comments only: the previous page's PageInfo endCursor

method.description: get: PR details. get_diff: the diff. get_status: combined commit status of the head commit. get_files: changed files (paginated). get_commits: commits (paginated). get_review_comments: review threads, each grouping review comments on one code location, with thread metadata and nullable current and original line ranges (line, start_line, original_line, original_start_line); current ones are omitted when unavailable, e.g. for outdated comments; paginate with perPage and after. get_reviews: reviews (paginated); for review comments use get_review_comments. get_comments: PR comments (paginated); use when the user doesn't specifically want review comments. get_check_runs: check runs (individual CI/CD jobs and checks) for the head commit.

name: pull_request_review_write
description: Create, submit or delete a pull request review, or resolve a review thread. create: new review, submitted if event is given, else left pending. submit_pending: submit the current user's existing pending review on this PR, using body and event. delete_pending: delete the current user's existing pending review on this PR. resolve_thread / unresolve_thread: need only threadId (node ID, e.g. PRRT_kwDOxxx); owner, repo and pullNumber are unused; a thread already in that state is a no-op.

method.description: The write operation to perform on pull request review.

threadId.description: Review thread node ID (e.g. PRRT_kwDOxxx), required for resolve_thread and unresolve_thread. Get it from pull_request_read with method get_review_comments.

name: push_files
description: Push multiple files to a GitHub repository in a single commit

files.description: Files to push, each with path and content

name: request_copilot_review
description: Request a GitHub Copilot code review for a pull request, for automated feedback, usually before requesting a human reviewer.

name: search_code
description: Fast, precise code search across all GitHub repositories with GitHub's native search engine. Best for exact symbols, functions, classes or code patterns.

fields.description: Fields to return per result (default all). Omitting 'repository' and 'text_matches' drops the largest data.

query.description: GitHub code search query. Terms are ANDed; supports `OR`, `NOT` and `"quoted phrase"` for exact match. Qualifiers: `repo:owner/repo`, `org:`, `user:`, `language:`, `path:dir` (prefix match), `filename:exact.ext`, `extension:`, `in:file`, `in:path`, `size:`, `is:archived`, `is:fork`. Max 256 chars. Examples: `WithContext language:go org:github`; `"package main" repo:o/r`.

name: search_commits
description: Search commits across one or many GitHub repositories with GitHub's commit search syntax, to find specific changes, authors or messages. Default branch only.

query.description: Commit search query; matches commit messages on the default branch only. Scope it with `repo:owner/repo`, `org:` or `user:` (unscoped queries match all of GitHub, usually not wanted). Other qualifiers: `author:`, `committer:`, `author-name:`, `committer-name:`, `author-email:`, `committer-email:`, `author-date:`, `committer-date:` (support `>`, `<`, `>=`, `<=` and `YYYY-MM-DD..YYYY-MM-DD` ranges), `merge:true|false`, `hash:`, `tree:`, `parent:`, `is:public`. Examples: `repo:owner/repo fix panic`; `org:github author:defunkt committer-date:>=2024-01-01`.

sort.description: Sort by author or committer date (default best match)

name: search_issues
description: Search issues by natural-language semantic matching. Best for conceptual or paraphrased queries (e.g. "login fails after password reset"). Already scoped to is:issue.

fields.description: Fields to return per result (default all). Omitting 'body', 'reactions' and 'labels' drops the largest data.

owner.description: Optional repository owner; with repo, limits results to that repository

query.description: Natural-language query. Include alternative wordings as plain words, not joined with OR.

repo.description: Optional repository name; with owner, limits results to that repository

name: search_pull_requests
description: Search pull requests across GitHub repositories with issue search syntax, already scoped to is:pr

fields.description: Fields to return per result (default all). Omitting 'body', 'reactions' and 'labels' drops the largest data.

owner.description: Optional repository owner; with repo, limits results to that repository

query.description: Query in GitHub pull request search syntax

repo.description: Optional repository name; with owner, limits results to that repository

name: search_repositories
description: Find GitHub repositories by name, description, readme, topics or other metadata.

minimal_output.description: Return minimal repository info (default true). When false, modern clients get extra curated details (not the full GitHub API object); legacy clients keep full GitHub API repository objects.

query.description: Repository search query; supports advanced search syntax, e.g. 'machine learning in:name stars:>1000 language:python', 'topic:react', 'user:facebook'.

name: search_users
description: Find GitHub users by username, real name or other profile information.

query.description: User search query, auto-scoped to type:user, e.g. 'john smith', 'location:seattle', 'followers:>100'.

sort.description: Sort by followers, repositories or join date

name: sub_issue_write
description: Add, remove or reorder sub-issues of a parent issue in a GitHub repository.

after_id.description: ID of the sub-issue to place it after (give after_id or before_id)

before_id.description: ID of the sub-issue to place it before (give after_id or before_id)

method.description: add: add a sub-issue to the parent. remove: remove it from the parent. reprioritize: reorder within the parent, using after_id or before_id. To move a sub-issue to a new parent, use add with replace_parent=true; there is no writable parent field.

replace_parent.description: True replaces the sub-issue's current parent. Only with method 'add'.

sub_issue_id.description: ID of the sub-issue to add (not its issue number)

name: ui_get
description: Fetch UI data for MCP Apps (labels, assignees, milestones, issue types, branches, issue fields, reviewers).

method.description: The type of data to fetch

repo.description: Repository name (required for labels, assignees, milestones, branches, issue fields, reviewers)

name: update_issue_comment
description: Update the body of an existing issue or pull request conversation comment. Cannot update pull request review comments.

comment_id.description: Numeric ID of the issue or PR conversation comment to update; not a PR review comment ID.

name: update_pull_request
description: Update an existing pull request in a GitHub repository.

draft.description: true = draft, false = ready for review

reviewers.description: Usernames or ORG/team-slug teams to request reviews from

name: update_pull_request_branch
description: Update the branch of a pull request with the latest changes from the base branch.

expectedHeadSha.description: The expected SHA of the pull request's HEAD ref
